requirements.detail: A2 validator must pass over all 341 partitions.
A2 must remain a pre-router candidate build.
The replay input cutoff must remain sealed before 2025.
The preregistered P3R execution contract must be present.
Every frozen signal, router, hold-rule, and A3B source must be hashed.
A3B control parity, dense completed-bar audit, gap resolution, and deterministic omission resolution must validate offline.
C2 requires a canonical 301-decision membership ledger.
D2 requires a canonical 301-decision membership ledger.
E2 requires a canonical 301-decision membership ledger.
The six-asset 688-candidate control must match RD16L authority.
The six-asset 688-row evaluated ledger must match RD16L authority.
The six-asset 567-trade ledger must match RD16L authority.
Full operational Top-6 candidate coverage must be at least 95%.
Every completed causal member bar requires one audit decision.
Historical-source gaps must be resolved against operational memberships.
Every LOAO omission must have deterministic resolution; BCHSV-USDT and PEPE-USDT require actual replacements.
A3 review cannot execute replay, routing, exits, returns, network requests, post-2024 access, or production.
